in_marathi.name: Shivpoojan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worship of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivpoojan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivpoojan is derived from the words Shiva (God of Destruction and Renewal) and Poojan (worship). This name signifies the act of dedicating oneself to the worship of Lord Shiva. It is a name that embodies devotion, spirituality, and a deep connection to the divine.
